text: Mira visited the northern camp last week, but she has never been to the northern camp.
Tom has three brothers, but he has no siblings.
Tom finished the report yesterday, but he never started it.
The water tank is full, but there is no water in it.
Some of the colonists came to the meeting, but none of them stayed away.
Mira took off her helmet and came inside, but not in that order.
Tom broke a finger yesterday, but not one of his own.
Mira will repair the radio or the pump today, but she may well repair both.
